## How it works

Each file focuses on a specific type of mathematical operation, such as curve, ellipse, line, and point calculations.

- `curve.test.ts`: Tests curve-related functions.
- `ellipse.test.ts`: Tests ellipse-related functions.
- `line.test.ts`: Tests line-related functions.
- `pca.test.ts`: Tests Principal Component Analysis functions. (Defines: rotate)
- `point.test.ts`: Tests point-related functions.
- `polygon.test.ts`: Tests polygon-related functions.
- `range.test.ts`: Tests range-related functions.
- `segment.test.ts`: Tests segment-related functions.
- `vector.test.ts`: Tests vector-related functions.
